title: SegNeXt: Rethinking Convolutional Attention Design for Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Multi-scale convolutional attention built from cheap strip convolutions (k x 1, 1 x k) instead of self-attention, with a Hamburger decoder.
evidence: R: about +2.0 mIoU on ADE20K at equal or lower compute vs prior SOTA; 90.6 mIoU VOC test. In arXiv 2603.13044 SegNeXt is among the top general-purpose models on small 2D medical sets.
adaptation: MSCAN-B ImageNet weights, grey replicated, 512 px, add a full-res skip before the head; strip kernels suit long axis-aligned gridlines (recall 0.33) and long cracks along busbar directions; cheap enough for 5-fold CV.
min_experiment: Arm SegNeXt-B + full-res skip; baseline house; metrics gridline IoU/recall, crack relF1@2, mIoU_rob; kill if gridline IoU < 0.313 and crack relF1@2 < 0.881.

alt_notes.adaptation: Strip kernels align with long axis-parallel gridlines (gridline recall 0.33) and long cracks; MSCAN-B ImageNet weights, 1-ch replicated, add a full-res skip; cheap enough for 5-fold CV and ensembling.
alt_notes.min_experiment: SegNeXt-B + full-res skip at 512 vs house; metrics gridline IoU/recall, crack relF1@2, mIoU_rob; kill if gridline IoU < 0.313 and crack relF1@2 < 0.881.
